title: Build the Agent Task Run data model
description: Restructure the private Claude Agent platform so that Agents and Tasks are stored independently, and each Task can contain multiple Runs executed by different Agents.
completion_criteria: Agents and Tasks are stored in separate directories
Each Task has its own structured metadata and background file
Each Task can contain multiple Runs
Each Run can be executed by a different Agent
Each completed Run can append a placeholder update to the Task background
